pages.text: $(l)Calculation families$()$pBasic Calculator — Two inputs; basic combinations and many research-gated conversions.$pScientific Calculator — Two inputs; a different recipe family, not an extra input slot.$pAtomic Calculator — Placed three-input atomic recipes.$pFlawless Calculator — Four-input flawless recipes plus installed modules.$pDocking Station — Uses the family of the calculator placed in its special slot.$pDynamic Calculator — Three lanes: basic inputs 1–2, scientific 3–4, atomic 5–7.$pA recipe is selected from the family supported by the current device. A Scientific recipe does not become a Basic recipe because both devices have two slots. Item components, required counts and research can also distinguish apparently similar ingredients.$pPortable operations are immediate and return their container contents safely when closed. A time field in their recipe data does not create a hidden processing timer. Placed processors use their program time and server overrides.$pScientific examples: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pFlawless examples: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:machines/docking_station)Docking Station$()$p$(l:foundations_calculator:machines/dynamic_calculator)Dynamic Calculator$()$p$(l:foundations_calculator:calculators/installing)Install and choose modules$()
